I replied to Tobias in a thread on their #central-random message. I confirmed the corrected figure: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats.

They said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else. I didn't open or edit their #central-team post. Instead I suggested they correct it there so the team sees the right number. A seat count is an account detail rather than a money figure, so it was fine to repeat in the channel.
